spans.s:
Akra.--In several passages of the Rigveda this word means, according to Geldner, ‘horse.’ Roth suggests that ‘riding horse’ is the precise sense. Cf. aśva.
Foot notes i. 143, 7; 189, 7; iii. 1, 12; iv. 6, 3; x. 77, 2.
Vedische Studien, 1, 168, 169.
Zeitschrift der Deutschen Morgenländischen Gesellschaft, 48, 118. Cf. Max Müller, Sacred Books of the East, 32, 414.
